page.layout: One printed page, a title page. Centred block of text at the top, then a woodcut vignette (a tree with a banner and a landscape), then the place name below the vignette, then a small imprint line at the foot.
page.notes: The large title lines above the vignette (JACOBI ALTING, dum viveret, OPERUM, TOMUS SECUNDUS, Commentarii Theorico-Practici..., Parallelismi...) are printed mirror-reversed. They are show-through from the other side of the leaf, so I have left them out. The banner of the vignette is curled and only partly legible; its words are not transcribed. The small imprint line at the foot ("Excudit GERARDUS BORSTIUS...") is also mirror-reversed show-through and is left out. The blue library stamp (Bayerische Staatsbibliothek München), the handwritten shelf mark ("2207", "AA6", "v.2") and the tear at the left edge are not printed text and are not transcribed. The vignette is an engraving and is described here, not transcribed.
